name: Apicbase
oneLiner: Back-of-house management platform for multi-site foodservice businesses, covering recipes and menu costing, inventory, purchasing and production, which Apicbase now describes as AI-powered.
bestFor: Multi-unit restaurant groups, hotel F&B operations and central kitchens that want one system for recipes, food cost, stock and supplier ordering across sites.

updates.text: Hosted APX·25 (Apicbase Partnerships Experience), a new flagship event for hospitality, foodservice and technology executives.

features: Central recipe and ingredient library with automatic recipe and menu costing
Menu engineering and allergen information drawn from recipe data
Inventory counts and stock levels across locations
Production planning for central kitchens and multi-outlet operations
Sales-based forecasting and food cost reporting across sites
Integrations with POS and ordering systems, including Square and Deliverect

pricing.text: Custom pricing; Apicbase does not publish prices. Quotes depend on the number of locations and modules.

notes: Web search budget limited this research; apicbase.com could not be fetched. Customers come from casestudies.com, which indexes Apicbase's own case studies (Poule & Poulette multi-unit operations, Pentahotels multi-property menu rollouts, The Avocado Show inventory variance); verify on apicbase.com before citing details. No dated 2025-2026 product release was found; Apicbase exhibited at Hospitality Tech Expo, ExCeL London, 29-30 Sept 2026 (no source URL captured), and Partnerbase lists a Vita Mojo partnership (aggregator only, not used). The APX·25 date is from an Eventbrite listing (Nov 27). Integrations are from Square App Marketplace and Deliverect integration pages. Forecasting is from a 2021 funding article; the 'AI-powered' positioning is current per Apicbase's expo description, but specific AI features are unconfirmed. Original review had no stats to drop.
